item.title: BioCryst Eye Disease Candidate
item.description:
• Summary: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals has discontinued its eye disease candidate after a second failed attempt to find a viable indication. The decision to cull the program underscores challenges in developing therapies for ophthalmic conditions and will allow BioCryst to refocus resources on other pipeline assets.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Viridian Thyroid Eye Disease Phase 3
item.description:
• Summary: Viridian Therapeutics reported positive Phase 3 data for its drug VRDN-001 (anti-IGF-1R antibody) in thyroid eye disease, demonstrating significant improvements in proptosis and diplopia. The results vindicate the drug's potential and support a regulatory filing for this debilitating condition.
  • MoAs: Anti-IGF-1R antibody: inhibits insulin-like growth factor-1 receptor, reducing inflammation and fibroblast activation in orbital tissues.
  • Sources: BioSpace
